statement.desc: MySQL/MariaDB 데이터베이스 현재 시간 및 서버명 조회

commands.statement: SELECT NOW() AS ServerDate, @@hostname AS ServerName;

statement.desc: Oracle 데이터베이스 현재 시간 및 서버명 조회

commands.statement: SELECT SYSDATE AS "ServerDate", host_name AS "ServerName" FROM v$instance

statement.desc: PostgreSQL 데이터베이스 현재 시간 및 서버명 조회
SQLite 데이터베이스 현재 시간 및 서버명 조회

commands.statement: SELECT DATETIME('now', 'localtime') AS ServerDate, 'localhost' AS ServerName;

statement.desc: SQL Server 데이터베이스 현재 시간 및 서버명 조회

commands.statement: SELECT GETDATE() AS ServerDate, @@SERVERNAME AS ServerName;

SELECT 'OK' AS ResultCode, 'true' AS IsValid, 'false' AS HasError, NULL AS DeletedDate, 'localhost' AS ServerName, 'admin,user' AS Roles, 'release,stable' AS Tags, '' AS Warnings, 'A' AS Items, 75 AS Score, DATETIME('now', 'localtime') AS ServerDate;

SELECT TOP 100 M.* FROM [Message] AS M INNER JOIN ConversationMember AS CM ON M.ConversationID = CM.ConversationID AND CM.UserID = @UserID WHERE M.IsDeleted = 0 AND M.UserID != '00000000000000000000000000000000'
AND FREETEXT(M.MarkdownText, @Content)
AND M.UserID IN (SELECT [value] FROM STRING_SPLIT(@SearchUsers, ','))
AND CONVERT(DATETIME, @StartedAt + ' 00:00:00') < M.CreatedAt
AND M.CreatedAt <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @EndedAt + ' 23:59:59')
AND CONVERT(DATETIME, @EqualAt + ' 00:00:00') < M.CreatedAt AND M.CreatedAt <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @EqualAt + ' 23:59:59')
AND M.ConversationID IN (SELECT [value] FROM STRING_SPLIT(@ConversationIDs, ','))
SELECT * FROM RoleUser AS RU WHERE 1<2 AND
RU.UserID = #{TransformRole}

statement.desc: SQLite JSON 필터 SQL 검증 예제

commands.statement:
WITH SearchData (UserID, Content, Score, IsDeleted) AS ( SELECT 'user001', 'HandStack guide', 90, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'user002', 'Filter sample', 70, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'user003', '100% literal_value!', 50, 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'user004', 'Deleted message', 100, 1 ) SELECT M.UserID, M.Content, M.Score FROM SearchData AS M WHERE M.IsDeleted = 0
ORDER BY M.UserID;
